Ch132 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 132)

Subject: Markov chains | ID: 65275

Proposition

Let X be a Harnack space with polynomial structure S. Then the cohomology group is finite-dimensional for all n.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the torsion-free spectral family \(R_{01320011}\), the image is precompact in the Fock space topology.

Step 2. Applying the subharmonic interpolation theorem to \(R_{01320012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. By the parabolic spectral theorem, we decompose \(P_{01320013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the parabolic spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through Fourier approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
